messages:
Maria (CS Lead): Hey team — putting together a compact customer-facing runbook for onboarding + account-health checks for pilot accounts. Focus: caching, batching, streaming best-practices and renewal-risk signals. Short ask: review, add missing items, and confirm which we can share verbatim with customers. TL;DR list at bottom.

Dan (Eng): love it, please add example for token-budget config and recommended batch sizes per model class.

Maria (CS Lead): good call. Draft excerpt:

> Recommended ops checklist for pilot customers:
> - Warm pools: start with 2 warm instances per 10 active tenants; scale to 5/10 if concurrency > 20
> - Client-side batching: client SDK should batch for 50ms or 8 requests, whichever first
> - Server-side batching: suggest max batch 256 tokens or 64 requests depending on latency SLO
> - Streaming fallback: enable streaming when single-request latency > 100ms to maintain UX
> - Cache keys: use (tenant_id, route, prompt_hash_prefix) and TTL 60s for short-lived sessions
>
> We can share the above as bulletproof guidance.

Olivia (PM): Can we add a renewal-risk signal mapping?

Maria (CS Lead): yes — simple rules:
- If 7d MAU drops > 40% vs baseline -> High risk
- If average latency increases > 2x for 3 consecutive days -> Medium/High
- If errors > 1% and support ticket open -> High
Include recommended mitigation playbook per signal (prefill, reduce model size, enable cache warmup).

Teddy (SRE): small note on warm pools: prefer jittered startup to avoid thundering herd. Add sample Kubernetes probe snippet:

```
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /health
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  periodSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 3
```

Dan (Eng): sample client SDK code for batching:

```js
// pseudo
batcher.add(req)
setTimeout(() => batcher.flush(), 50)
if (batch.length >= 8) batcher.flush()
```

Maria (CS Lead): Also include a one-page customer-facing checklist at start with 3 actions:
1) Confirm token budget & SLA expectations
2) Enable route-level cache and 60s TTL
3) Turn on streaming for UX-sensitive flows

ops-bot: Note created: runbook/cs/pilot-wellness-v1 link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pilot-wellness-v1 :page_facing_up:

Olivia (PM): Love it. Maria, can you make a trimmed version (1 pager) we can include in onboarding email?

Maria (CS Lead): putting it in my queue — will drop a 1-pager by EOD tomorrow. Thanks for reviews :thumbsup:
